Application to amend zoning for 329 and 331 Spruce St (Z-24-10)
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required prior to permit issuance. The proposed application must be reviewed by city planners, other agencies, and City Council prior to anything being built.
1000123305 Ontario Inc is proposing to build a nine storey multi-unit apartment building containing sixty-four residential dwelling units with eighty-eight bedrooms for a density of 587.4 bedrooms per net hectare. The proposed development also includes twenty-two parking spaces, and twenty-six bicycle parking spaces with access from Spruce Street.
Zoning bylaw changes requested include:
reduce minimum tower separation and interior lot line distance to 6 m from the 11 m distance required for the three storeys above the podium.
Removal of the "H" Holding provision from the subject lands.
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Tallest tower: 9 storeys
Number of units: 64
Unit sizes: mix of one, two bedrooms
Housing types: apartments
Parking
Parking: 22
Bicycle parking: 26
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
